Install Elsewhere

Install the extension as PinGlide in Chrome.

  1. Open the project ↗, choose Code → Download ZIP, then unzip it.
  2. Open chrome://extensions in Chrome and enable Developer mode.
  3. Choose Load unpacked and select the folder containing manifest.json.
  4. Visit Pinterest, open the extension from the toolbar, and enable it for the current tab.

Click a Pin, then use ← and → to browse.
